title: Automate sandbox evidence retention and reconstruction index
goal: Create and continuously verify a compact reconstruction index for every authoritative RCE receipt, report, active sandbox file, lease record, lifecycle record, and archived candidate without deleting evidence or granting production authority.
acceptance_criteria: P0-008 authoritative receipt is present and true
all authoritative receipts P0-001 through P0-008 are indexed when present
each indexed file records path sha256 byte count and evidence class
active sandbox lifecycle staging and lease records are indexed
archived sandbox candidates are indexed without deletion
reconstruction index is deterministic for unchanged evidence
missing or changed indexed evidence fails closed
production and external destinations remain prohibited
blocked_by: RCE-P0-008 authoritative lease receipt not yet persisted
